decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to utilize artifacts to quickly generate mana and card advantage, while using disruptive spells like Chalice of the Void and Force of Will to control the opponent's game plan. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Sai, Master Thopterist can generate a board presence of artifact creatures, while Urza's Saga can tutor for key artifacts. The deck aims to apply pressure early with aggro strategies and leverage the power of various artifacts to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping into powerful artifacts and disrupting the opponent with counterspells and disruptive artifacts. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive threats and efficient removal, while generating card advantage and creating a board presence with artifact tokens. The key strategy is to deploy a wide range of artifacts and utilize them to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent, while also having answers to disrupt their game plan.

This deck focuses on using the Doomsday combo to win the game quickly by assembling the necessary cards to set up a winning condition. The deck includes cards that allow for efficient card selection and mana acceleration, as well as protection spells to ensure the combo goes off successfully. With the right sequencing and timing, the player can use these cards to manipulate their library and guarantee a victory with the Thassa's Oracle win condition. The deck's strategy revolves around quickly assembling the combo pieces and executing the plan before the opponent can disrupt it.

The main strategy of this deck revolves around quickly getting out powerful, game-changing creatures such as Griselbrand, Emrakul, or Uro by using the card Show and Tell in conjunction with Omniscience. The goal is to cheat these big threats into play for free and overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to respond. The deck also includes a strong suite of cantrips, counterspells, and card selection tools to ensure consistency and efficiency in executing the combo. Additionally, Cunning Wish provides versatility and access to a sideboard of powerful silver bullets to deal with various threats.

This deck aims to quickly ramp up mana using Cloudpost and Tron lands while controlling the board with cards like Pithing Needle and Endurance. The key strategy revolves around tutoring for lands with cards like Expedition Map and Crop Rotation to quickly assemble a powerful mana base. Once the deck has enough mana, it can cast game-winning threats like Primeval Titan and Emrakul, the Aeons Torn to overwhelm the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes utility lands like Karakas and Bojuka Bog to disrupt the opponent's game plan and secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively control the tempo of the game by playing efficient and disruptive threats such as Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent while also using powerful instant spells like Lightning Bolt and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to quickly establish board presence and disrupt the opponent's strategy, allowing it to close out games efficiently. The mana base is tailored to support the deck's aggressive tempo strategy by including a mix of fetchlands and dual lands to ensure consistent access to the deck's powerful spells.

The main concept of this deck is to establish early board presence with efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while disrupting opponents with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck aims to control the tempo of the game by using cards like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent to apply pressure to the opponent. The deck also includes burn spells like Lightning Bolt to finish off opponents quickly. The mana base is optimized to ensure consistent access to all the necessary colors for spells.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish early threats on the board while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal spells. The deck focuses on playing efficient creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Delver of Secrets, backed up by powerful spells like Lightning Bolt and Force of Will to control the game. By utilizing card selection and tempo plays with cards like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to apply pressure on the opponent while maintaining a strong defensive position with disruptive spells like Daze and Wasteland.

The main concept of this deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent while disrupting their game plan with countermagic like Daze, Force of Will, and Force of Negation. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat while cycling through the deck quickly with cantrips like Brainstorm, Ponder, and Expressive Iteration. The deck also utilizes Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base and maintain tempo advantage throughout the game.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying threats onto the battlefield while disrupting the opponent with counterspells and removal. The key strategy is to maintain tempo by efficiently answering threats and countering spells, while using efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent to quickly close out the game. The deck also utilizes cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure consistency in drawing the necessary cards. Additionally, the mana base is streamlined to support the aggressive playstyle, with a focus on fetching dual lands and utilizing Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base.

The deck revolves around controlling the game through counterspells and removal spells while generating advantage with cards like Hullbreacher and Snapcaster Mage. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Teferi, Time Raveler, while also having a win condition in Shark Typhoon. Overall, the deck focuses on tempo and card advantage to outlast the opponent in a game of attrition.
